description: Checks whether a Shield install works, by the site's public key (pub_...): "waiting" (nothing yet), "test_visit" (a visit from localhost arrived before the first real one, so the SDK sends; it is not stored), "receiving" (real visits arrive) or "refused" (with the reason), plus one sentence to act on or pass to the site owner. Call it after loading a page with the SDK on it. Needs no API key; never pass the secret key.
name: shield_install_status
title: Shield install status
